name: Andrea D. Bergman

biography.text: Bergman earned a B.A. from Skidmore College (1990) and a J.D. from Santa Clara University School of Law (1995). She worked at the ACLU of New Jersey before law school, practiced briefly after graduation, served as a research-and-writing attorney for the federal defender, and was an Assistant Federal Public Defender in New Jersey from 1999 until her appointment. Her position is part-time and centered on Fort Dix matters.
